ModMetaData.name: The Moat
ModMetaData.author: Keldarton
ModMetaData.description:
Forces your starting colony map (and only that map) to generate with an impassable mountain along one side and open plains on the rest. Built for players who want a subterranean colony with one or a few choke points.
DEFENSIVE HIGHLIGHTS - You can build your mountain base deep, with no caves, no surprise internal open spaces or ancient dangers. Ores are present normally. - You can design the base for a single choke point: every raid, manhunter pack and mechanoid threat comes from the plains side. - No drop pods through the roof: the whole mountain is covered by thick overhead mountain. - Concentrated defenses: no 360-degree perimeter to defend. Put your turrets, bunkers and traps at the entrance. - If you want full relax: combine this mod with the "no infestations" one.
MAP GENERATION - Choose your side: the mountain sits on the west side by default. Move it to the east, north or south side in the mod settings. - The mountain: solid rock with thick overhead roof. No caves, no hollow pockets, no insect hives, no special features (ancient dangers, ruins, geysers, monolith). Only mineable ore veins, at the density of a vanilla mountainous map, even on flat tiles. - The plains: flat open land without hills or lakes. All vanilla surface features spawn there: trees, soil types, ancient dangers, ancient mech remains, steam geysers, ruins, roads, the Anomaly Void Monolith and wildlife. - Starting colony only: later settlements, quest sites, encounter maps and camps generate normal vanilla maps.
MOD SETTINGS (Options -> Mod Settings -> The Moat) - Mountain side: west, east, north or south (default: west). - Mountain size: 30% to 70% of the map (default: 50%). - Ore veins in the mountain (default: ON). - Remove lakes and water on the plains (default: ON). - Flatten hills on the plains (default: ON).
REQUIREMENTS - Harmony is required. Load it at the top of your mod list: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2009463077 - No DLC required. Works with Royalty, Ideology, Biotech, Anomaly and Odyssey. - Compatible with RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7.
SOURCE CODE https://github.com/federicogiorgi/TheMoat Issues and contributions are welcome.
